big_case.notes: An unpublished Fourth Circuit per curiam affirmance of a Rule 12(b)(6) dismissal without prejudice of a single-parcel Prince George's County water-and-sewer hookup dispute. Although the questions presented invoked Pakdel finality and Lexmark's critique of prudential ripeness with Pacific Legal Foundation and six amici in support, threshold factual concessions at the district-court hearing (whether petitioner ever formally applied for a DPIE administrative waiver) made it a poor vehicle that was denied without noted dissent.
